Knowledge Graph

Keywords and papers as a network. Keyword–keyword links are co-occurrence (same paper); paper–keyword links show which paper uses which keyword. Click any node to centre on it and show only its 1st- and 2nd-degree connections (click empty space or “Show all” to reset). Use Freeze to stop the layout moving.

On citations: the spreadsheets don't include reference lists, so true "who cited whom" links can't be drawn from this data. Paper–paper links here are shared-keyword similarity (a relatedness proxy). Export the Scopus records with References and I can draw real citation arrows.
